name: Grade 8 IT: Computing Systems and AI
description: Hardware, software, processor, memory, storage, input, output, operating systems, logic, AI, machine learning, training, testing, open source, and responsible remixing.

words.definition: The physical parts of a computing system.
words.example: Processor, memory, and storage are hardware.

words.definition: Programs and instructions that run on hardware.
The part of a computer that carries out instructions.
Temporary storage used while programs are running.
words.example: Memory helps the computer work with open files.

words.definition: Long-term space for saving files and programs.
words.example: The project file was saved in storage.

words.definition: Data or actions received by a computing system.
Data or action produced by a computing system.
Sending and receiving data between systems.
Software that manages hardware, files, and programs.
words.example: The operating system controls program execution.

words.definition: A sequence of instructions for a computer.
words.example: The program told the computer what operations to perform.

words.definition: Rules used to make decisions in computing.
words.example: AND, OR, and NOT are logic operators.

words.definition: A table that shows the result of logical expressions.
words.example: The truth table showed when AND was true.

words.definition: Software or systems that perform tasks that seem to require human intelligence.
A type of AI that learns patterns from data.
Giving examples to a machine learning model so it can learn patterns.
A model's guess or output based on learned patterns.
words.example: The prediction was correct for most images.

words.definition: Code that people can inspect, use, and often modify under a license.
words.example: Open source examples help people learn.

words.definition: To adapt or build on an existing project.
words.example: The student remixed a web example and gave credit.
